email.accountingDefaults.description: Manage tenant-owned sender defaults, reusable placeholders, sample links, and workflow rules.
email.accountingDefaults.links.descripti: Safe placeholder URLs only. Do not paste real customer Google Drive or Sheets links here.
email.accountingDefaults.links.help: Reusable placeholder URLs for template previews. Use safe placeholders, not real customer Drive or Sheets links.
email.accountingDefaults.links.title: Sample link placeholders
email.accountingDefaults.placeholders.de: Default sample values available to templates, such as periods and filing deadlines.
email.accountingDefaults.placeholders.he: Reusable accounting values that templates can use as custom variables, such as a quarter name or filing deadline.
email.accountingDefaults.replyTo.help: Reply-to mailbox used for accounting emails. Leave blank if each sender chooses it later.
email.accountingDefaults.replyTo.label: Default reply-to
email.accountingDefaults.scope.descripti: These values belong only to the current tenant. Add PCA-specific values only inside the PCA tenant, not as global Operis defaults.
email.accountingDefaults.scope.help: Defaults are scoped to the current tenant only. PCA-specific values should be configured only inside the PCA tenant.
email.accountingDefaults.scope.title: Tenant accounting defaults
email.accountingDefaults.senderName.help: Name shown as the sender when accounting emails are composed from this tenant.
email.accountingDefaults.title: Email Accounting Defaults
email.compose.accountingValues.descripti: Fill custom accounting variables for this preview. These values are not saved to the template.
email.compose.accountingValues.help: Fill template-specific accounting placeholders, such as quarter, deadline, payable amount, or report link, for this preview only.
email.compose.accountingValues.title: Accounting values
email.compose.company.description: Selecting a company fills company variables and linked people/recipient variables when available.
email.compose.company.help: Choose the Operis customer company whose values should fill system variables such as companyName and companyEmail.
email.compose.company.label: Company
email.compose.companyCode.help: Optional company code used by templates such as accounting subjects.
email.compose.companyEmail.help: Company email from the customer record; editable for this preview only.
email.compose.companyName.help: Filled from the selected company; editable for this preview only.
email.compose.contactNames.help: Names of people linked to the company. If none are linked, this stays empty until the user fills it manually.
email.compose.description: Preview a published tenant template with selected company/contact and accounting values. This does not send email.
email.compose.greeting.help: Greeting generated from linked people when possible; falls back to a generic greeting if no contacts exist.
email.compose.preview.description: System variables come from the selected company/people in the future compose integration; this page lets users verify output now.
email.compose.preview.title: Live preview
email.compose.recipientEmails.help: Recipient email addresses from linked people. Users can type addresses manually if no people are linked.
email.compose.template.help: Choose a published tenant-owned template. Draft and archived templates are not available here.
email.compose.template.label: Template
email.compose.title: Compose Email Preview
email.templates.blocks.heading: Heading
email.templates.create.description: Tenant-owned templates with workflow rules, typed variables, live preview, and visual-builder blocks.
email.templates.create.title: Create Email Template
email.templates.edit.description: Update tenant-owned template content, rules, placeholders, preview, and visual-builder blocks.
email.templates.edit.title: Edit Email Template
email.templates.empty: No saved email templates yet. Create a tenant-owned template from scratch.
email.templates.errors.defaultValuesJson: Default values must be valid JSON
email.templates.form.blocks.description: Editable blocks are stored as template blocks; rich text blocks support selected-text typography.
email.templates.form.blocks.help: Build the email body from editable blocks. Use rich text when users need selected-text typography, links, lists, and alignment.
email.templates.form.blocks.label: Visual builder blocks
email.templates.form.blocks.title: Visual builder blocks
email.templates.form.bodyPlaceholder: Write your email body here. Use {{variables}} in content.
email.templates.form.category.help: Business grouping for filtering, such as accounting, onboarding, or sales.
email.templates.form.category.label: Category
email.templates.form.customVariables.des: Define only values that come from accounting context, rules, or manual input. Sample values are preview-only.
email.templates.form.customVariables.hel: Add extra placeholders that are not stored on the company record, such as upload links, filing deadlines, quarter names, or payment amounts.
email.templates.form.description.help: Internal note that explains when this template should be used.
email.templates.form.description.label: Description
email.templates.form.hasActivity.help: Marks this template for companies with accounting/tax activity in the period.
email.templates.form.hasActivity.label: Company has activity
email.templates.form.hasCit.help: Marks this template for Corporate Income Tax messages.
email.templates.form.hasCit.label: Includes CIT
email.templates.form.name.help: Human-readable template name shown in the template list and composer.
email.templates.form.name.label: Name
email.templates.form.noCustomVariables: No custom variables yet. Use system variables for company/contact data, or add accounting fields like quarterLabel and deadlineDate.
email.templates.form.preheader.help: Short preview text many mail clients show after the subject.
email.templates.form.preheader.label: Preheader
email.templates.form.priority.help: Lower numbers appear first when multiple templates match later.
email.templates.form.priority.label: Selection priority
email.templates.form.quarter.help: Optional quarter condition used later by accounting workflow selection.
email.templates.form.quarter.label: Quarter
email.templates.form.richTextHint: Select part of the email body, then use the toolbar for headings, size, color, bold, lists, alignment, links, and other typography.
email.templates.form.showInGenerator.hel: Controls whether accounting compose/generator screens can offer this template when status allows it.
email.templates.form.status.help: Draft templates are editable, published templates are selectable, archived templates are hidden from normal use.
email.templates.form.status.label: Status
email.templates.form.subject.help: Email subject line. Insert variables like {{companyName}} so they are filled during compose.
email.templates.form.subject.label: Subject
email.templates.form.systemVariables.des: Filled automatically from the selected Operis company and linked people during email compose.
email.templates.form.systemVariables.hel: These values come from the company selected during compose. If no people are linked, contact variables stay empty or use a generic greeting.
email.templates.form.templateKey.help: Stable unique key used by rules and future workflow selection. Use lowercase words like quarterly_tax_with_activity.
email.templates.form.templateKey.label: Template key
email.templates.form.variableKey.help: Placeholder name inserted as {{variableName}} in the subject or body.
email.templates.form.variableKey.label: Variable key
email.templates.form.variableSample.help: Example value used only in the live preview. It is not a real customer value.
email.templates.form.variableType.help: Controls how this sample value is previewed, for example link variables render as clickable links.
email.templates.form.variableType.label: Type
email.templates.form.whenToUse.descripti: Choose simple business conditions instead of editing raw rules JSON.
email.templates.form.whenToUse.help: These choices are saved as rule metadata for future workflow selection. They do not send email or auto-select templates yet.
email.templates.form.whenToUse.label: When to use this template
email.templates.form.workflow.help: Main accounting workflow where this template should appear later.
email.templates.form.workflow.label: Email purpose
email.templates.preview.description: Preview uses sample/default values only and does not send email.
email.templates.preview.help: Shows how the subject and body will look using sample values. Use Compose Preview later to choose a specific company.
email.templates.preview.title: Live preview
email.templates.table.name: Name
email.templates.table.subject: Subject
email.templates.title: Email Templates
